precedence: motor present and spine in water
semantics.moving: Movement component exists AND velocity.magnitude > move_speed
semantics.sprint: Movement component exists AND velocity.magnitude > sprint_speed
semantics.magnitude: Full XYZ vector, no projection onto ground/body plane; finite native input policy. Unity Mathf.Sqrt receives a single-precision squared magnitude and returns a float.
semantics.numeric_adapter: C uses wider sum-of-products then rounds to float at Mathf.Sqrt argument; double sqrt then float result, matching the already-inspected installed Mono scalar expression behavior. Not every Unity runtime/compiler is qualified.
semantics.ordinary: All remaining ground/nonwater velocities, including walking and exactly4.5; not a request-for-no-input condition.
semantics.absent_movement: Ordinary ground branch; air and water still take precedence.
semantics.capability: Branch identification alone does not enable air/water/sprint presentation or first-person; no action/stamina admission or motion integration.
semantics.motor: Horizontal request minus current horizontal velocity: if magnitude >=12, normalized difference *12 + current. Cap per update, not acceleration*dt.

numerical_evidence.qualification: Separate offline installed-Mono replay; exporter does not run arithmetic proof.

installed: Normal generation checks source prefab. Optional --game verifies the actual installed serialized Motion_Equip payload without running the game; report remains local.
